Why Nothing Worked

Most treatments address the surface

Cystic and hormonal acne start inside - in your gut, your hormones, your biology. That is why topicals stop working the moment you stop using them.

Surface treatments address symptoms, not causes
Topicals, antibiotics, and Accutane work while you're using them. Stop, and the root cause is still there - unchanged. That is why it comes back.
Cystic acne starts inside the body
Hormonal imbalance, gut inflammation, and nutrient deficiencies drive the kind of acne that does not respond to skincare. These are systemic issues.
Everyone gets the same generic protocol
Most dermatologists treat skin problems generally. Hormonal acne and inflammatory acne have different drivers - and need different approaches.
Without fixing the root, it always comes back
Until you understand what is actually causing the inflammation - diet, gut health, hormones - the acne has nowhere to go but back.
The truth about chronic acne
"The best outcomes come from treating the patient, not the symptom. Acne is almost always a sign of something deeper."
Varden Hill specialises exclusively in inflammatory and cystic acne - not general dermatology.
Every protocol is built around your biology - your gut health, hormones, diet, and history. No two patients get the same plan.
Your provider checks in weekly and adjusts as your skin responds. You are not dropped after a prescription.
Most patients who had tried Accutane twice, Curology, countless topicals - see real change within 60-90 days.

Questions

Before you book.

Because everything else treated the surface. Topicals, Accutane, antibiotics - they suppress or reduce sebum while you're using them. They do not address why your body is producing the inflammation in the first place. Varden Hill identifies the root cause - gut, hormones, diet - and builds a protocol that fixes it at the source. That is why it holds when you stop, rather than coming back.

Most patients see meaningful improvement within 60 to 90 days. The timeline depends on the severity of the root cause and how closely the protocol is followed. Your provider tracks progress weekly and adjusts the approach if needed. Most patients who clear do so within 14 to 16 weeks.

Your provider checks in weekly specifically so that does not happen silently. If something is not working, we adjust before it becomes a problem. Root cause protocols are iterative - your biology gives us information as the protocol runs, and we use that information to dial it in. If after a full protocol cycle there is no measurable progress, we will be the first ones to tell you why and what the next step should be.

Traditional dermatologists treat skin problems broadly - acne, eczema, psoriasis, rosacea, and dozens of other conditions. They have general protocols and limited appointment time. Most patients with cystic or hormonal acne leave with Accutane or an antibiotic - the same approach regardless of what is actually driving the inflammation. Varden Hill specialises exclusively in inflammatory and cystic acne, and we treat the cause rather than the symptom. Every patient gets a tailored protocol, weekly check-ins, and a provider who is adjusting the plan as your body responds.
